}

				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_sun_moon_lake }
				pmr_dam_sun_moon_lake_on_level = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_des_moines_rapids }
				pmr_dam_des_moines_rapids_on_level = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_cachapoal_canyon }
				pmr_dam_cachapoal_canyon_on_level = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_lower_yalu }
				pmr_dam_lower_yalu_on_level = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_edea_falls }
				pmr_dam_edea_falls_on_level = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_victoria_nile }
				pmr_dam_victoria_nile_on_level = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_rincon_del_bonete }
				pmr_dam_rincon_del_bonete_on_level = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_uhl_river }
				pmr_dam_uhl_river_on_level = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

				limit = { is_building_type = building_dam_tone_river }
				if = {
					limit = { level >= 4 }
					debug_log = "PMR_DAM|probe_lvl|tone_river|4/2|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { level >= 3 }
					debug_log = "PMR_DAM|probe_lvl|tone_river|3/2|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { level >= 2 }
					debug_log = "PMR_DAM|probe_lvl|tone_river|2/2|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { level >= 1 }
					debug_log = "PMR_DAM|probe_lvl|tone_river|1/2|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { always = yes }
					debug_log = "PMR_DAM|probe_lvl|tone_river|0/2|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
				if = {
					limit = { level_after_queued_constructions >= 4 }
					debug_log = "PMR_DAM|probe_q|tone_river|4/2|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { level_after_queued_constructions >= 3 }

					limit = { always = yes }
					debug_log = "PMR_DAM|probe_q|uhl_river|0/1|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

on_yearly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = { pmr_dam_yearly }
}

pmr_dam_yearly = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_technology_researched = electrical_generation }
			debug_log = "PMR_DAM|bur_year|-|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]|surveys [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_active')|0] building [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_building_now')|0]"
		}
	}
}
